message.content: {"basis": "The pie chart titled “Global Energy Consumption by Source” (chart_1, upper-left title) labels four slices with their consumption shares: “Nuclear (40%)” (pale-yellow upper-left sector), “Hydroelectric (25%)” (dark-red lower-left sector), “Renewables (20%)” (orange lower sector), and “Fossil Fuels (15%)” (light-orange right sector). Comparing the printed percentages, 40% > 25% > 20% > 15%, so Nuclear is the largest global energy-consumption category. The routing criterion is “Largest global energy consumption category,” and the option “Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring” matches that source.", "option_label": "Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring"}
